cve-now:51dbffaf85199a51.summary: The Linux kernel's vfio/platform code let a program map a read-only region and then upgrade that mapping to writable with mprotect(). The fix blocks this upgrade for regions that are meant to be read-only.

cve-now:eb328ed3b24d07c3.summary: In the Linux kernel's Bluetooth L2CAP code, a zero value set through the L2CAP_OPTIONS socket option for the transmit window is stored and later used when the channel runs in ERTM mode. cve-now:d99af830fac9110d.title: CVE-2026-99807: Linux kernel crash in Bluetooth L2CAP from invalid TxWindow
cve-now:d99af830fac9110d.summary: The Linux kernel's Bluetooth L2CAP code can crash when a peer sends a configuration request with an out-of-range TxWindow value in ERTM mode. cve-now:2a19ea221d08bfdd.title: CVE-2026-99810: Linux kernel read-only mapping bypass in VFIO fsl-mc driver
cve-now:2a19ea221d08bfdd.summary: The Linux kernel's vfio/fsl-mc driver can let a read-only memory mapping of a device region be upgraded to writable with mprotect(). The attack can be launched remotely without logging in, but it requires a user to take an action, such as opening a crafted link.

cve-now:d18aec6844f7cd7a.title: CVE-2026-116397: WPTasty Business Directory missing authorization checks allow data tampering
cve-now:d18aec6844f7cd7a.summary: Business Directory, a WordPress plugin from WPTasty, has a missing authorization flaw that lets a user with low-level access change or view data they should not be able to. The attack can be carried out remotely by someone who has logged in with a basic account.

cve-now:909b638a402b8558.title: CVE-2026-135949: Themeisle MPG reflected XSS in page generator
cve-now:909b638a402b8558.summary: Themeisle's MPG plugin (multiple-pages-generator-by-porthas) for WordPress contains a reflected cross-site scripting flaw. An attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in, but a user must first be tricked into clicking a crafted link, after which the attacker's script runs in that user's browser.

cve-now:4de6e24bd3950375.title: CVE-2026-135958: WP Review Slider stored cross-site scripting in review carousel output
cve-now:4de6e24bd3950375.summary: The jgwhite33 WP Review Slider plugin has a stored cross-site scripting flaw that lets an attacker inject malicious scripts into web pages it generates. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, but a user must take an action for the attack to work.

cve-now:d9f10d886f9df380.title: CVE-2026-135951: Designinvento DirectoryPress Reflected XSS in directory listing plugin
cve-now:d9f10d886f9df380.summary: Designinvento's DirectoryPress plugin for WordPress contains a reflected cross-site scripting flaw that lets an attacker run scripts in a victim's browser. The attack can be launched remotely without logging in, but it requires the victim to take an action, such as opening a crafted link.

cve-now:278ccf7f3d39c635.title: CVE-2026-135960: PayTR Sanal POS WooCommerce – iFrame API sensitive data exposure in payment gateway files
cve-now:278ccf7f3d39c635.summary: The PayTR Sanal POS WooCommerce – iFrame API WordPress plugin places sensitive information in a file or directory that anyone can reach, which lets an attacker retrieve the embedded sensitive data. An attacker can exploit this remotely over the network without logging in or any action by a user.

cve-now:1e707ea3d9ca25b0.title: CVE-2026-135961: Nks Continuous Image Carousel With Lightbox stored XSS in image carousel
cve-now:1e707ea3d9ca25b0.summary: Stored cross-site scripting in the Continuous Image Carousel With Lightbox WordPress plugin from Nks lets an attacker plant malicious script that is saved on the site and runs in other users' browsers. It can be reached remotely without logging in, but it requires a user to take an action, such as opening a page.

cve-now:28fc347a7af3ee8a.title: CVE-2026-135942: Tutor LMS reflected cross-site scripting in WordPress plugin
cve-now:28fc347a7af3ee8a.summary: Themeum's Tutor LMS plugin for WordPress, through version 4.2.1, has a reflected cross-site scripting flaw. An attacker can remotely, without logging in, inject script that runs in a victim's browser, but only if the victim is tricked into opening a crafted link or page.

cve-now:657cc24257694b98.title: CVE-2026-137905: FFmpeg denial of service in IMF asset map parser
cve-now:657cc24257694b98.summary: FFmpeg versions from 5.0 up to (but not including) 8.1.3 can crash when they parse a crafted IMF asset map file. An attacker would need a local foothold and the victim would have to open the malicious ASSETMAP.xml file, and the result is a denial of service rather than code execution.

cve-now:ab116b472d440325.title: CVE-2026-107189: GNU m4 denial of service in frozen-state file reload
cve-now:ab116b472d440325.summary: GNU m4 has an integer overflow in how it reloads frozen-state files passed with the -R option. A local attacker who tricks a user into opening a malicious file can crash the program, causing a denial of service.

cve-now:97004f469b1a4c3c.title: CVE-2026-137906: FFmpeg denial of service in IMF demuxer via crafted playlist
cve-now:97004f469b1a4c3c.summary: FFmpeg versions from 5.0 before 8.1.3 can crash when the IMF demuxer opens a crafted IMF Composition Playlist whose virtual track has no resources. An attacker with local access could trigger this by getting a user to open the malicious file, which causes a denial of service.

cve-now:3158d609d77a3e86.title: CVE-2026-137911: FFmpeg out-of-bounds read in XWD encoder scanline padding
cve-now:3158d609d77a3e86.summary: FFmpeg, a multimedia library, has an out-of-bounds read flaw in its XWD image encoder that can be triggered locally by an attacker who controls the width of video encoded to XWD, and it requires a user to take an action. The bug can crash the application or leak heap memory contents into the output image.

cve-now:56302809f5195408.title: CVE-2026-137910: FFmpeg out-of-bounds read in PCX encoder leaks heap memory
cve-now:56302809f5195408.summary: FFmpeg has an out-of-bounds read in its PCX image encoder that a local attacker can trigger without logging in, if a user encodes an image whose width the attacker controls. The read can crash the application or leak heap memory contents into the output image.

cve-now:667435b14be9e49f.title: CVE-2026-137909: FFmpeg NULL pointer dereference crash in XSUB subtitle encoder
cve-now:667435b14be9e49f.summary: FFmpeg, a multimedia library, is affected by a NULL pointer dereference in its XSUB subtitle encoder that can crash applications. An attacker who can supply a crafted PGS or DVB subtitle file to a local user, who must take some action to open it, can trigger the crash when the decoded subtitles are passed directly to…

cve-now:4ccfb5e8cd7eb7e0.title: CVE-2026-137908: FFmpeg memory leak in SVT-AV1 Dolby Vision encoding
cve-now:4ccfb5e8cd7eb7e0.summary: FFmpeg has a memory leak in its SVT-AV1 encoding path that a local attacker can trigger by supplying crafted video with some frames missing Dolby Vision metadata, when Dolby Vision RPU coding is enabled. The attack needs a user to take an action, and it can leak memory or, in builds with assertions enabled, crash the…

cve-now:e99d88ec6991d7d4.title: CVE-2026-137907: FFmpeg heap buffer overflow in boxblur filter
cve-now:e99d88ec6991d7d4.summary: FFmpeg has a heap buffer overflow in its boxblur filter that a local attacker can trigger without logging in, but only if a user processes a crafted 32-bit float image such as PFM or OpenEXR. Successful exploitation can crash the application or possibly allow code execution.

cve-now:a0a135dda6113c26.title: CVE-2026-125633: Samba denial of service in AD DC DNS record handling
cve-now:a0a135dda6113c26.summary: Samba's Active Directory domain controller has a type confusion flaw in its DNS management interface. A remote attacker with low privileges, such as a DnsAdmins member, can add a crafted HINFO record that crashes the directory's RPC worker, and repeating the request keeps the directory's remote-call service from…

cve-now:2e48ca2b7cd14760.title: CVE-2026-137744: Free5GC resource leak DoS in N3IWF IKEv2 SA payload parsing
cve-now:2e48ca2b7cd14760.summary: Free5GC is affected by a denial-of-service flaw in its N3IWF IKEv2 parser, specifically in how it processes security association payloads. A remote attacker can trigger it over the network without logging in, which can disrupt the service.

cve-now:9876bab4eed710ae.title: CVE-2026-123755: PowerDNS DNSdist denial of service in outgoing TCP connection handling
cve-now:9876bab4eed710ae.summary: An attacker who is able to send zone transfer queries (AXFR or IXFR) to PowerDNS DNSdist can remotely cause an outgoing TCP connection to the backend to hang, which denies service to other clients that try to reuse that same connection. The attacker needs low-privilege access to the network service, and the crafted…

cve-now:0eedd15a3f8ff5a5.title: CVE-2026-123756: PowerDNS DNSdist denial of service in internal webserver
cve-now:0eedd15a3f8ff5a5.summary: PowerDNS DNSdist is affected by an input validation flaw that lets a network attacker with low-level privileges cause a denial of service by sending crafted HTTP queries to its internal webserver. The webserver is not enabled by default and is protected by an access control list.

cve-now:8ce71376d7d77328.title: CVE-2026-85563: PowerDNS DNSdist cache poisoning via DNS over HTTPS GET body parsing
cve-now:8ce71376d7d77328.summary: PowerDNS DNSdist processes the HTTP body of DNS over HTTPS GET queries instead of the query in the HTTP path. A remote attacker with a low-privilege login can use this to poison the cache of a caching HTTP reverse proxy placed in front of DNSdist.

cve-now:9cda0cb3f72d1ce0.title: CVE-2026-85562: PowerDNS DNSdist auth bypass via spoofed X-Forwarded-For in DNS over HTTPS
cve-now:9cda0cb3f72d1ce0.summary: PowerDNS DNSdist uses the first of several duplicate X-Forwarded-For headers instead of the last, when DNS over HTTPS is set to trust these headers and a reverse proxy adds a new header rather than replacing existing ones. A remote attacker who does not need to log in can exploit this to spoof its own IP address.

cve-now:beba0e30baaa948b.title: CVE-2026-137745: Free5GC authentication bypass in SMF association setup
cve-now:beba0e30baaa948b.summary: A flaw in the SMF component of Free5GC lets an attacker bypass authentication by spoofing, and the attack can be launched remotely without logging in. The issue is in the association setup request handling, and a patch is available to fix it.

cve-now:da65c0a66e4251e5.title: CVE-2026-85567: PowerDNS DNSdist authentication bypass in the internal HTTP API
cve-now:da65c0a66e4251e5.summary: PowerDNS DNSdist fails to disable its internal HTTP API when the API key is set to empty, as its documentation says it should. An attacker on the network whose IP address is allowed by the webserver ACL can bypass authentication and get read-only access to the API.

cve-now:0ae9d9ec75f63c9f.title: CVE-2026-85564: PowerDNS DNSdist denial of service via lingering QUIC streams
cve-now:0ae9d9ec75f63c9f.summary: DNSdist from PowerDNS can be pushed into heavy memory use by an attacker who reaches it remotely over the network with low-privilege access. The attacker does this by cancelling QUIC streams while DNSdist is fetching a response, and DNSdist keeps the memory for each cancelled stream until the whole QUIC connection…

cve-now:8f9fcc43d050f984.title: CVE-2026-85561: PowerDNS DNSdist access control bypass in DoH backend connection reuse
cve-now:8f9fcc43d050f984.summary: PowerDNS DNSdist can reuse an outgoing TCP connection for a DNS over HTTPS query from a different client when DNS over HTTPS trusts X-Forwarded-For headers and the proxy protocol is used to a backend. This makes the backend treat that query as coming from the first client. An attacker can trigger this remotely over…

cve-now:dea02ef8f777a9ca.title: CVE-2026-85565: PowerDNS DNSdist denial of service in DoH query handling
cve-now:dea02ef8f777a9ca.summary: PowerDNS DNSdist can be knocked over by a remote attacker with low privileges who sends oversized DNS over HTTPS queries, which causes a synchronization problem on outgoing TCP connections to its backend. The backend may then refuse queries, return server failures, or close the TCP connection.

cve-now:8711e4e64285500e.title: CVE-2026-85566: PowerDNS DNSdist record smuggling and IP spoofing via EDNS Client Subnet
cve-now:8711e4e64285500e.summary: An attacker who can reach PowerDNS DNSdist over the network, without logging in, can send a specially crafted DNS query to forge its source IP, smuggle DNS records, or get past EDNS option filtering. This only works when EDNS Client Subnet is enabled between DNSdist and its backend.

databreaches:009ee7b6d9f73a28.summary: Lee Young-ho reports: According to industry sources on the 27th, the association detected the cyber breach early this month and commissioned a detailed investigation by an outside specialist agency. cve-now:737e0de9bc74b71e.title: CVE-2026-134961: Cozy Vision SMS Alert Order Notifications access control bypass from missing authorization checks
cve-now:737e0de9bc74b71e.summary: A missing authorization flaw in the WordPress SMS Alert Order Notifications plugin from Cozy Vision Technologies Pvt. Ltd. lets an attacker get around access controls. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in or any action by a user, and it can slightly affect data integrity and availability.

cve-now:4a4d7b818467fa08.title: CVE-2026-135016: Ricardo Martins PagBank / PagSeguro Connect unauthorized data access via missing authorization checks
cve-now:4a4d7b818467fa08.summary: The PagBank / PagSeguro Connect plugin for WordPress, from Ricardo Martins, has a broken access control flaw caused by missing authorization checks. An attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in or any action by a user, and gain limited ability to view and change data.

cve-now:a1e0b1ba8991d572.title: CVE-2026-134939: David Lingren Media LIbrary Assistant reflected XSS in WordPress plugin pages
cve-now:a1e0b1ba8991d572.summary: The Media LIbrary Assistant plugin for WordPress has a reflected cross-site scripting flaw that lets a remote attacker, without logging in, inject malicious scripts into a page, but a user must first be tricked into opening a crafted link. Once the script runs in the user's browser, it can act within the site as that…

cve-now:303196b2d4a6f8cf.title: CVE-2026-135911: PI Web Solution Product Enquiry for WooCommerce stored cross-site scripting in enquiry form
cve-now:303196b2d4a6f8cf.summary: Product Enquiry for WooCommerce, a WordPress plugin from PI Web Solution, contains a stored cross-site scripting flaw. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, but a user must take an action, such as opening a crafted page, before the attacker's script runs in that user's browser.

cve-now:d632ba587717bcba.title: CVE-2026-135930: TMS Amelia authentication bypass in booking plugin
cve-now:d632ba587717bcba.summary: The Amelia booking plugin for WordPress, published by TMS as ameliabooking, has an authentication bypass flaw that lets an attacker spoof another user's identity. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in.

cve-now:209e4448b8463998.title: CVE-2026-134717: Simple Membership stored XSS in membership pages
cve-now:209e4448b8463998.summary: Stored cross-site scripting in the Simple Membership plugin from wp.insider for WordPress lets an attacker inject malicious script into pages. The attack can be launched remotely, without logging in, but it requires a user to take an action, such as opening a crafted page.

cve-now:345f482fa371e0b0.title: CVE-2026-135933: Tobias WebinarIgnition privilege escalation via incorrect role assignment
cve-now:345f482fa371e0b0.summary: The WebinarIgnition plugin for WordPress, from Tobias, contains a privilege escalation flaw caused by incorrect privilege assignment. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and lets an attacker gain higher privileges on the site.

cve-now:df38bbcf32c807fb.title: CVE-2026-137746: Free5GC denial of service in SMF
cve-now:df38bbcf32c807fb.summary: Free5GC's SMF component has a flaw that lets an attacker consume resources and disrupt availability. The attack can be carried out remotely over the network, without logging in.

cve-now:d637fcacb2305c14.title: CVE-2026-135950: Featured Image from URL stored XSS in generated page content
cve-now:d637fcacb2305c14.summary: The fifu.app Featured Image from URL plugin for WordPress has a stored cross-site scripting flaw that lets an attacker inject malicious scripts into web pages it generates. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, but a user must take some action for the attack to work.

cve-now:cb2b737e802402ff.title: CVE-2026-135948: Themeisle MPG stored XSS in page content handling
cve-now:cb2b737e802402ff.summary: The MPG plugin for WordPress, made by Themeisle, has a stored cross-site scripting flaw. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, but a user must take an action, such as opening a crafted page, for the malicious script to run.

cve-now:d129e91afb9a5056.title: CVE-2026-134957: WP Chill Image Photo Gallery Final Tiles Grid cross-site scripting in gallery tiles grid
cve-now:d129e91afb9a5056.summary: The WordPress Image Photo Gallery Final Tiles Grid plugin from WP Chill has a DOM-based cross-site scripting flaw that lets an attacker run malicious scripts in a victim's browser. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, but it requires a user to take some action first.

cve-now:24edd40ad842825f.title: CVE-2026-133720: WP Telegram Widget and Join Link script injection via XSS in social widget
cve-now:24edd40ad842825f.summary: Cross-site scripting in the WP Telegram Widget and Join Link plugin for WordPress, from WP Socio, lets an attacker inject script into pages through reflected input. The attack can be launched remotely without logging in, but it requires a user to take an action, such as opening a crafted link.

cve-now:1c43c3489bf76d95.title: CVE-2026-134963: Webdeclic WPMasterToolKit remote code execution in WordPress plugin
cve-now:1c43c3489bf76d95.summary: The WPMasterToolKit plugin for WordPress, from Webdeclic, has a code injection flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the affected site. An attacker can reach it remotely over the network with a low-privilege account, and no user action is needed.

therecord:9a79f6f175dbf801.title: Software giant SAP confirms cyber incident amid reports of source code breach
therecord:9a79f6f175dbf801.summary: German software giant SAP confirmed a cybersecurity incident following reports that hackers infiltrated its software development infrastructure, potentially gaining access to the company’s source code.

cve-now:0e7a5f65e45c9429.title: SZB-c60eeeaa33: eSentire reports malicious Setup Assistant app on Microsoft Store delivered Vinci RAT
cve-now:0e7a5f65e45c9429.summary: According to eSentire, a Microsoft Store app named Setup Assistant, published by ETPS Ltd, installed a backdoor that deployed the Vinci RAT on victim machines. The app was no longer available on the Microsoft Store when the research was published, and it was not clear whether Microsoft or the publisher removed it.

cve-now:5129e0e18b7170b2.title: CVE-2026-106169: Google Cloud Application Integration remote code execution in eventbus
cve-now:5129e0e18b7170b2.summary: A flaw in the eventbus execution of Google Cloud Application Integration lets an attacker with a low-privilege login run code remotely by sending a crafted serialized Java object. Google Cloud patched the issue on 22 September 2026, and no customer action is needed.

thehackernews:4895aa5a5bc0ae74.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a cyber attack in which a threat actor leveraged a Microsoft Store application to deliver a remote access trojan (RAT) called Vinci RAT. cve-now:f32778816f08814d.title: CVE-2026-14569: Hitachi Energy RTU500 series CMU firmware format string flaw in TLS, PPP and CAM logging leaks memory (Update: CVSS score changed from 8.7 to 6.1)
cve-now:f32778816f08814d.summary: Update: CVSS score changed from 8.7 to 6.1. A format string flaw in the logging function for TLS, PPP and CAM in Hitachi Energy's RTU500 series CMU firmware lets a remote attacker, without logging in or any user action, cause sensitive memory disclosure or a denial of service.

cve-now:cf62e28ea48139f4.title: CVE-2026-124981: Siemens Mendix OIDC Provider session hijack via JWT introspection endpoint
cve-now:cf62e28ea48139f4.summary: The Siemens Mendix OIDC Provider does not properly validate the integrity of JWTs sent to its token introspection endpoint, so tokens can be matched to legitimate token records based only on their jti value. Remote attackers without logging in could hijack an account session by obtaining the jti of an active token.

cve-now:08c3180ce451565f.title: CVE-2026-80481: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition sensitive data exposure in log files
cve-now:08c3180ce451565f.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, before the fixed release, writes sensitive information into a log file. A local attacker with low-level privileges on the system could read that data, exposing information they should not have access to.

cve-now:99cb9aedba877a5d.title: CVE-2026-80482: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition denial of service via System.exit() in J2EE component
cve-now:99cb9aedba877a5d.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, before the fixed release, has a J2EE bad practice flaw in which the software calls System.exit(). A local attacker with low-level account access could trigger it to crash the service and cause a denial of service.

cve-now:2563059d2739d33a.title: CVE-2026-118968: Qt Framework denial of service in WAV audio decoding
cve-now:2563059d2739d33a.summary: A denial-of-service flaw in the WAV audio decoding of the Qt Multimedia module in Qt Framework lets a local attacker disrupt the affected software. The attacker needs local access and no login, but a user must take an action for the attack to work.

cve-now:e45a218330738e10.title: CVE-2026-135278: Siemens Mendix Runtime session persists after account deactivation
cve-now:e45a218330738e10.summary: Siemens Mendix Runtime does not end an existing session when a user's account is deactivated, so a user who is deactivated while signed in can keep using that session. A remote attacker with a low-privilege login can use this to read and change data within their previous permissions.

cve-now:14dacbb546a19a8c.title: CVE-2026-80480: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition denial of service via certificate validation flaw
cve-now:14dacbb546a19a8c.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition contains an improper certificate validation flaw. An attacker with local access, and no login needed, could potentially cause a denial of service or expose information.

cve-now:aa5aacbf084fb062.title: CVE-2026-80483: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition session theft via off-by-one error
cve-now:aa5aacbf084fb062.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition contains an off-by-one error that an attacker with local access can exploit without logging in, which could allow session theft. The attacker must be on the same system or local environment, and no user action is needed.

cve-now:6617df82e057bbfd.title: CVE-2026-123761: PowerDNS Authoritative incorrect cached DNS answers in views processing
cve-now:6617df82e057bbfd.summary: Logic errors in PowerDNS Authoritative's view processing can cause it to return incorrect cached results. An attacker can reach this remotely, without logging in, and no user action is needed.

cve-now:07668f343903a56e.title: CVE-2026-123762: PowerDNS Authoritative access control bypass in catalog zone updates
cve-now:07668f343903a56e.summary: PowerDNS Authoritative is affected by a bug where a catalog zone update that adds a zone already existing in a different backend creates a duplicate zone in the catalog's backend, which can hide the existing zone depending on backend load order. An attacker can reach this remotely over the network, but only with high…

cve-now:fbea7ca7ecd9a7f0.title: CVE-2026-123760: PowerDNS Authoritative denial of service in LMDB backend
cve-now:fbea7ca7ecd9a7f0.summary: PowerDNS Authoritative with the LMDB backend can be made unresponsive. An attacker with low-privilege access over the network can trigger zone rectification on a zone whose count of Empty Non-Terminal entries exceeds the max-ent-entries setting, which leaves the process spinning with the LMDB database locked.

cve-now:f54edf9ef8d5daca.title: CVE-2026-80485: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition local command injection in system script handling
cve-now:f54edf9ef8d5daca.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition contains an OS command injection flaw that lets an unauthenticated attacker with local access run injected commands on the system, which can lead to script injection. The attacker must already be on the local machine, and no login or user action is required.

cve-now:82ef65995135cf27.title: CVE-2026-80484: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition information disclosure via hard-coded cryptographic key
cve-now:82ef65995135cf27.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition contains a hard-coded cryptographic key flaw. A low-privileged attacker with local access could exploit it to expose sensitive information.

cve-now:7d1235672afd54c8.title: CVE-2026-123758: PowerDNS Authoritative denial of service in forward notification queue
cve-now:7d1235672afd54c8.summary: A race condition in how PowerDNS Authoritative handles its forward notification request queue can crash the software if too many UDP notify packets for one zone arrive in a short time. An attacker can reach this remotely over the network, but only with high-level privileges.

cve-now:630d16b35bda30f2.title: CVE-2026-123757: PowerDNS Authoritative remote config injection in BIND autosecondary
cve-now:630d16b35bda30f2.summary: PowerDNS Authoritative (the pdns package) is affected. An attacker can send a notify request over the network, without logging in, that makes the server add the root zone as a secondary domain. This leaves the configuration invalid, so the backend cannot start after the next restart until an administrator fixes it by…

cve-now:6026d7e7c207de55.title: CVE-2026-137938: Sparkle local privilege escalation via installer download race
cve-now:6026d7e7c207de55.summary: Sparkle, the software updater, has a race condition in its installer that a local user with low privileges can exploit to gain elevated (privilege escalation) access. cve-now:06076551f42b982d.title: CVE-2026-137937: PDFio out-of-bounds read/write in AES decryption
cve-now:06076551f42b982d.summary: PDFio contains an integer underflow in its AES decryption code that lets a crafted, AES-encrypted PDF read and write memory out of bounds, crashing the application or corrupting the heap. An attacker needs local access and a user to open the malicious file, which is then processed by pdfioFileOpen().

cve-now:0736e970d18d301a.summary: PowerDNS Authoritative (package pdns) is affected when it uses its Bind backend. A remote attacker who needs no login and no user action can send data during AXFR zone transfers, causing wrong or invalid data to be serialized.

cve-now:df6a68353e3d880a.summary: PowerDNS Authoritative, the software in the pdns package, has a flaw where catalog zones accept the root zone as a member. An attacker on the network, without logging in, could act as a catalog zone provider to have PowerDNS provision the root zone from a source the attacker chooses.

cve-now:8a6243cfd54970a9.summary: Sparkle, a software update framework, has a local privilege escalation flaw in its root updater launcher. cve-now:ff37e30ceeda5d57.title: CVE-2026-124728: PowerDNS Authoritative denial of service via TSIG operation logic flaws
cve-now:ff37e30ceeda5d57.summary: PowerDNS Authoritative has logic flaws in how it handles TSIG operations that can lead to a crash. An attacker can trigger this remotely over the network without logging in.

cve-now:88d52b6283ee2a4c.title: CVE-2026-124727: PowerDNS Authoritative zone corruption via AXFR in Bind backend
cve-now:88d52b6283ee2a4c.summary: Attackers who can reach the PowerDNS Authoritative server over the network, without logging in, can trigger a zone transfer (AXFR) of obsolete record types into a zone served by the Bind backend. That transfer leaves the zone unable to load afterwards, so an administrator must manually edit the zone file to recover it.

cve-now:c9897684bd664ed4.title: CVE-2026-137936: Payload authorization bypass in client upload handling
cve-now:c9897684bd664ed4.summary: Payload, a content management system, has an authorization bypass in its client upload handling. A logged-in user with upload permissions can reach files in upload collections they are not authorized for, and the attack can be carried out over the network.

cve-now:31ea85789c99adde.title: CVE-2026-80499: Dell Secure Connect Gateway Virtual Edition unauthorized file access via path manipulation
cve-now:31ea85789c99adde.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition contains an external control of file name or path flaw. A low-privileged user with local access could exploit it to gain unauthorized access.

cve-now:cf62312a4a2a071b.summary: Pillow crashes when a crafted TIFF file is decoded and an ImageMath divide or modulo operation uses -1 on the resulting image. A local attacker with no login needed can crash the affected application by getting a user to process such a file.

cve-now:7ae4d97e293f84bb.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition contains an improper certificate validation flaw that lets an attacker on the local system, without logging in, expose sensitive information. cve-now:6317ad092a881fba.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition contains an incorrect permission assignment for a critical resource. A local attacker with low-privilege access could exploit it to cause a denial of service.

cve-now:3b4a308b90a7e717.summary: Roundcube Webmail is affected. An attacker who can reach the service over the network and has a low-privilege user account can change contact group membership in other users' SQL address books, or add other users' contacts to their own groups.

cve-now:49bca8890c646536.title: CVE-2026-137943: Roundcube Webmail cross-site scripting in HTML editor via text/enriched
cve-now:49bca8890c646536.summary: Roundcube Webmail is affected by a cross-site scripting flaw in its HTML editor, which handles text/enriched email parts.
